summary: Learn adoption scorecards, benefits registers, and dashboards to prove change value. Book practical intermediate training today.
lede: Change adoption metrics and benefits tracking give change and transformation professionals a way to measure adoption and benefit outcomes. The course covers setting baselines and KPIs, tracking adoption, utilisation and proficiency with survey and system-usage data, building dashboards and benefits registers, analysing variance, and reporting evidence to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support change or transformation work and now need to prove adoption and benefits with disciplined measurement.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with change management, project delivery, or business improvement contexts. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards, interpreting basic KPI trends, and working with spreadsheets or reporting templates. Prior exposure to change plans, stakeholder maps, or benefits registers will help you move faster through the practical exercises.
